mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is active whenever the rate is below the threshold, and the signal is always monitored without requiring a specific trigger event.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% within a 3-month window signals an economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises above 5.0% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and decrease in real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a shift from consumption-driven to investment-driven demand, which is associated with economic uncertainty and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises and RSAFS falls, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle contraction regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines below its 6-month average during late-cycle contraction, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% in a 3-month window signals accelerating inflation, which triggers central bank tightening and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises above 3.0% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below its 6-month average signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% within a 3-month window signals aggressive policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises above 2.0% during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals a contraction in the real economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines below its 6-month average, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
